diagnosis.reasoning: Total prompt-token demand is essentially flat (+13%) and arrival rate actually fell, so the server is not being asked for more work overall; what changed is that the prefix cache hit rate collapsed from 0.97 to 0.07, so nearly every prompt token must now be computed (prefill_kv_computed +22260%, prefill_time +1359%), which drives KV usage up and floods the wait queue. prefill_cost, kv_cache_pressure and queueing all sit causally downstream of the cache collapse and move exactly as its consequences, so they are effects rather than causes; preemption never fired and host/gpu saturation show no independent signal.  Hence the prefix-cache efficacy loss is the root pathology, with the longer prompts (excluded workload input) only amplifying it.
